neighbours.label: a word inside a fixed multiword expression whose continuation is forced ('might as well', 'can no longer', 'whether or not', 'the rate at which', 'run afoul'), as against the same words in free combinations
fire: The tickets were free, so we might as well go to the concert.
After the flood, the farmers could no longer reach their fields.
We will hold the picnic whether or not it rains on Saturday.
Doctors measured the speed at which the drug left the blood.
Two shops ran afoul of the new rules on outdoor signs.
The missing file caused a series of errors in the report.
Since the bus is late, you may as well walk home with us.
Many readers can no longer find the old edition in stores.
quiet: The tickets were free, so we went to the concert with friends.
After the flood, the farmers waited a week to reach their fields.
We will hold the picnic on Saturday if the weather is fine.
Doctors measured how quickly the drug left the blood.
Two shops broke the new rules on outdoor signs.
The missing file caused several errors in the report.
Since the bus is late, you should walk home with us.
Many readers want to find the old edition in stores.
